# Screenshots

This directory holds the 6 screenshots referenced from the main README files.
**All current files are branded placeholders** (dark background, dashed frame,
"PLACEHOLDER" banner) generated by `scripts/make_placeholders.py`. Replace them
with real captures before the next release — keep the same filenames so the
README links keep working.

| File | What to capture |
| --- | --- |
| `01-live-stream.png` | Live logcat stream, level-colored rows scrolling |
| `02-filters.png` | Expanded filter panel + saved preset chips |
| `03-crashes.png` | Crashes & ANRs list with a crash card |
| `04-sessions.png` | Recording sessions list |
| `05-session-replay.png` | Session detail — Logs tab replay |
| `06-sdk-sample.png` | Sample app with SDK share sheet, or an imported SDK zip |

Capture guidelines:
- Size: 1080×2400 (portrait, ~9:20 aspect) PNG, to match the placeholders.
- Real device preferred over emulator (cleaner status bar).
- Keep theme (light vs dark) consistent across all 6 shots.

To regenerate placeholders after editing `scripts/make_placeholders.py`:
```bash
python3 scripts/make_placeholders.py
```
